title: SpaceContext
description: PROVISIONAL (pending founder WhatsApp handoff, 2026-08-12). The shape of the optional `spaceContext` field a moment-carrying record (Cursor, Receipt) may attach in a future minor revision, defined here as its own schema so the existing record schemas are not mutated. It says: this act happened in the flow of this space.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record's schema (semver: major.minor.patch).

spaceId.description: Id of the Space this act or moment belongs to.

institutionId.description: Id of the Institution the space belongs to, denormalized for records that travel without the Space itself.

cohortId.description: Id of the Cohort in whose flow the act happened, where relevant.

visibility.description: How far within the structure the moment may be seen: only its owner, the space's members, or the whole institution.
